setup: iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator on iOS 27.0, Release AOT. The baseline already downscales to display resolution and shares overlapping requests. The candidate adds a local-file queue with six slots on this host.
sourceFiles: The 12 distinct JPEG fixtures and their checksums are listed in image-fit-decoding.json.

rapidReplacement.setup: Changes the source URLs of all twelve visible images every 50 ms for five replacements. Each batch uses distinct file URLs linked to the original JPEGs. The timing window begins with the first batch and ends when all final-batch views have loaded.

concurrencyProbe.setup: An experimental actor semaphore limited local load tasks before implementing the production queue. 999 effectively disables the cap in the 12-image workload.

limits: These samples measure local files. HTTPS scheduling stays with the existing URLSession path.
Peak RSS includes process launch and setup. Compositor presentation and physical-device performance are outside this comparison.
